description: Data underlying the paper: Transit across cities: Comparing connectivity and accessibility across European intercity bus and rail service networks is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Rajat Verma, Oded Cats. This is a harmonised dataset of European intercity bus and rail service networks. It contains timetable, geography, population, network, inferred route-geometry and schedule-path tables for 28 European countries. It is companion to the manuscript of the same title submitted to the Journal of Transport Geography. Details provided in README. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: Parquet. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
